Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.basic_sql_prompt: SELECT repo_name, COUNT(path) AS num_files FROM sample_files GROUP BY repo_name ORDER BY num_files DESC LIMIT 10;
Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.cot_style_prompt:
WITH repo_stats AS (
  SELECT repo_name, COUNT(code) AS total_functions, COUNT(DISTINCT func_name) AS unique_functions, language AS primary_language
  FROM sample_files
  GROUP BY repo_name, language
)
SELECT repo_name, total_functions, unique_functions, primary_language
FROM repo_stats
WHERE total_functions > 5
ORDER BY total_functions DESC
LIMIT 20;
